newsitem.title: USA: PureTec sees flood costs about $400,000.
newsitem.headline: PureTec sees flood costs about $400,000.

text.p: PureTec Corp said Tuesday it expects flood damage to its plant in Sparks, Nev., will cost the company about $400,000 in insurance deductibles.
Those expenses would be posted in the second fiscal quarter ended January 31, it said.
The company also said that manufacturing operations have returned to full production at the plant since the flood, which occurred in January.
Chief Financial Officer Tom Gilboy said in a statement that the plant is adequately insured.

"We do not have final settlement of the claims yet, but the impact on the company's results should be limited to the cost of the insurance deductibles, which will be in the range of $400,000," Gilboy said.
